name: Health Care Services Delivery
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/HSD) — X12 005010 HSD segment element reference. New for Phase 3 (271), used at 2110C/2110D (up to 9 occurrences) to describe benefit limitation quantities (e.g. visits remaining, days remaining). HSD04-08 (sample selection modulus, time period qualifier/number of periods, delivery pattern codes) deliberately not modeled — core quantity/unit fields only, matching this project's own 'core fields, not exhaustive' precedent.
